capabilities: Apply a selected template automatically to every new note regardless of how it is created
Assign different templates to specific folders with hierarchy fallback
Match folder paths with * and ** wildcard patterns
Exclude folders from template application via ignore paths
Substitute {{title}}, {{date}}, and {{time}} variables with Moment.js format strings
extras: Installation via BRAT is documented for beta testing; the README links to an Obsidian Help page for Templates and to a feature-request thread as background.
intentEvidence: Processes {{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}} like the official Templates plugin
motivation: The author wanted a minimal way to get default templates without adopting Templater, responding to a long-standing feature request thread (3+ years of user requests).
problem: Obsidian's Templates core plugin only inserts templates manually, so every new note starts unstructured unless the user inserts a template each time.

relations.evidence: Processes {{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}} like the official Templates plugin
You don't need the complexity of Templater just for default templates

summary: Plugin that automatically applies a chosen template to every newly created note, with folder-specific templates, ignore paths, and date/time/title variables.
